headline: Solid E/SE swell with improving winds but very challenging. Overloaded early AM but organizing.
body:
Dawn to Midday: Solid well overhead to double overhead E/SE swell mix is on tap. We start the day with NNE winds so most areas look jumbled/poor and overloaded. Surf improves as the tide pushes in with lighter winds but still raw.
Afternoon Outlook: Surf looks to slowly ease over the PM. Winds turn more SW which will allow for OK conditions for some. Likely not flawless but worth watching closely.

headline: Solid E/SE swell with AM northerly winds. Easing winds in PM but very challenging.
body:
Dawn to Midday: Solid well overhead to double overhead E/SE swell mix is on tap. We start the day with NNE winds so key south facing areas look semi-clean but be prepared to work for it. Pumping at the right spots as the tide pushes in, just know your limits. 
Afternoon Outlook: Surf looks to slowly ease over the PM but plenty of strong overhead+ surf remains. Latest trends suggest N winds turn more westerly over the PM which results in improving surf across the region.

headline: Solid ESE/SE swell and SSW windswell mix with strong SW winds expected. Cleanish surf at E facers.
body:
Dawn to Midday: Looking rather unruly to start the day with a well overhead+ mix of surf and SSW winds. Wind protected areas look OK but otherwise, plenty of lingering lump and jumble. Rather challenging. 
Afternoon Outlook: Improving conditions are on track for E facing breaks with strong swell mix. PM is the window to target at spots that favor this solid swell and SW wind combination, likely not flawlessly clean but some gems out there and worth targeting for advanced/experts.

headline: Strong ESE and S swell mix, cleanest for Monmouth County in PM with SW/WSW winds.
body:
Dawn to Midday: Looking rather unruly to start the day with a well overhead+ mix of surf and SSW winds. Wind protected areas look semi-clean but otherwise, plenty of lingering lump and jumble. Very challenging AM. 
Afternoon Outlook: Improving conditions are on track with easing swell mix. Good shape from multiple swell directions and winds turn more SW to WSW. Mid to late PM is the window to target in Monmouth County, not flawlessly clean but some gems out there and worth targeting.
